item.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer, ASIC Simulation в NVIDIA, Київ, віддалено
item.description: What if your Python automation caught a critical ASIC bug before the physical silicon was even manufactured? At NVIDIA, our simulation platforms make that happen every release cycle! We are the System Ethernet QA Team at NVIDIA’s R&D center, responsible for the testing and qualification of virtual networking silicon (SimX) and software—from L2 forwarding and L3 routing to overlays, QoS, and security. With SimX, developers and QA engineers get hardware-free, early access to the ASIC for better debugging. We are looking for a Senior QA Software Engineer who combines network protocol expertise with strong Python automation skills. Does debugging a BGP EVPN route leak excite you as much as refactoring a test framework? Then we should talk! What we offer: 36 days of paid vacation a year, weekends on all public holidays, paid sick leaves, company paid parental leave for mothers and fathers. The most competitive salary on the market. NVIDIA shares (RSU and ESPP). Premium medical insurance for employees and their children/spouses. Life insurance. Professional courses at Ivy League Universities. Trainings and lectures. English or other languages classes. Personalized career development plan. Wellbeing programs. Annual performance, position, and salary reviews. Remote/hybrid or office work in the comfortable office in the city center (Leonardo Business Centre, near metro Teatralna and Zoloti Vorota). Parking. And these are not all the benefits that you will receive by joining NVIDIA! …

item.description: Ascendix Technologies is an AI and Real Estate Technology partner headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with offices in Poland, Portugal, and Ukraine. In this role, you’ll work with a small, collaborative team to ensure the reliability of both traditional software functionality and AI-driven features. You’ll combine manual testing, test automation, and LLM evaluation techniques to validate AI-generated responses, identify potential issues, and continuously improve product quality.
